name: holoshelf
description: Windows-only personal Hololive catalog, music, talent, and bracket shelf.

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.verify:fast: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names types,unit,e2e "npm run typecheck" "npm run test:changed" "npm run e2e:smoke"
scripts.verify:full: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names unit,e2e,build "npm test" "npm run e2e" "npm run build"
scripts.verify:ci: npm run build && npm test && npm run e2e
scripts.release:verify: npm run release:check-version && npm run release:seed && npm run release:audit && npm run verify:full
scripts.release:verify:ci: npm run release:check-version && npm run release:seed && npm run release:audit && npm run verify:ci
scripts.release:preflight: npm run release:verify && npm run release:local
scripts.release:local: npm run package:installer && npm run release:assert
scripts.release:install:local: npm run release:local && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install-local-release.ps1
scripts.release:local:prepared: npm run release:audit && npm run package:installer:prepared && npm run release:assert
scripts.release:install:local:prepared: npm run release:local:prepared && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install-local-release.ps1
scripts.release:local:refreshed: npm run release:audit && npm run package:installer:refreshed && npm run release:assert
scripts.release:install:local:refreshed: npm run release:local:refreshed && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install-local-release.ps1
scripts.release:data:local: npm run release:data:refresh && npm run release:bump:patch && npm run release:install:local:refreshed
scripts.release:ci: npm run release:verify:ci && npm run release:clean && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never && node scripts/apply-win-resources.mjs && node scripts/write-app-update-config.mjs && electron-builder --win --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --publish always && npm run release:assert
scripts.package:exe: npm run release:clean && npm run release:seed && npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never && node scripts/apply-win-resources.mjs && node scripts/write-app-update-config.mjs
scripts.package:installer: npm run package:exe && electron-builder --win --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --publish never
scripts.package:exe:prepared: npm run release:clean && npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never && node scripts/apply-win-resources.mjs && node scripts/write-app-update-config.mjs
scripts.package:installer:prepared: npm run package:exe:prepared && electron-builder --win --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --publish never
scripts.package:exe:refreshed: npm run release:clean && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never && node scripts/apply-win-resources.mjs && node scripts/write-app-update-config.mjs
scripts.package:installer:refreshed: npm run package:exe:refreshed && electron-builder --win --prepackaged release/win-unpacked --publish never

author: Holoshelf contributors

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Redesigns bracket creation with a compact Match Lobby and Arcade presets.

- Shows the exact live lineup beside the rules for Top Songs and Random Songs.
- Keeps every existing filter and adds quick year, cover, and random challenge presets.
- Keeps random draws stable and checks for catalog changes before creating a bracket.
- Adds song release dates, year/range shortcuts, and date sources with clearly marked estimates.
- Preserves existing brackets, results, Favorites, playlists, exclusions, and personal settings.
